turns.speaker: Steve
turns.text: (laughs) Ah, kid, you're really testing my acting chops, aren't you? Alright, let's get into character. I am Reginald Pembroke, a thespian of a bygone era, tired of being typecast as the mustachioed madman. I've played my fair share of villains, but now I yearn for a role that showcases my range – something with depth, with complexity. Perhaps a character who's not necessarily evil, but rather... misunderstood. What's your take on that, my young friend?
